0002.title: Acetic acid
0002.physicalDescription: Colorless liquid or crystals with a sour, vinegar-like odor. [Note: Pure compound is a solid below 62°F. Often used in an aqueous solution.]
0002.nioshRel: TWA 10 ppm (25 mg/m3) ST 15 ppm (37 mg/m3)
0002.measurementMethods: NIOSH 1603; OSHA ID186SG See: NMAM or OSHA Methods
0002.symptoms: irritation eyes, skin, nose, throat; eye, skin burns; skin sensitization; dental erosion; black skin, hyperkeratosis; conjunctivitis, lacrimation (discharge of tears); pharyngeal edema, chronic bronchitis

0525.title: Propane sultone
0525.physicalDescription: White, crystalline solid or a colorless liquid (above 86°F). [Note: Releases a foul odor as it melts.]
0525.measurementMethods: None available See: NMAM or OSHA Methods
0525.exposureRoutes: inhalation, skin absorption, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0525.symptoms: irritation eyes, skin, respiratory system; [potential occupational carcinogen]

0001.title: Acetaldehyde
0001.physicalDescription: Colorless liquid or gas (above 69°F) with a pungent, fruity odor.
0001.measurementMethods: NIOSH 2018, 2538, 3507; OSHA 68 See: NMAM or OSHA Methods
0001.exposureRoutes: inhalation, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0001.targetOrgans: Eyes, skin, respiratory system, kidneys, central nervous system, reproductive system
0001.symptoms: irritation eyes, nose, throat; eye, skin burns; dermatitis; conjunctivitis; cough; central nervous system depression; delayed pulmonary edema; In Animals: kidney, reproductive, teratogenic effects; [potential occupational carcinogen]

0259.title: 2-Ethoxyethyl acetate

0259.measurementMethods: NIOSH 1450; OSHA 53 See: NMAM or OSHA Methods

0259.targetOrgans: Eyes, respiratory system, gastrointestinal tract, reproductive system, hematopoietic system
0259.symptoms: irritation eyes, nose; vomiting; kidney damage; paralysis; In Animals: reproductive, teratogenic effects

0008.title: Acetylene

0008.measurementMethods: NIOSH Acetylene Crit. Doc. See: NMAM or OSHA Methods

0006.title: Acetonitrile

0296.exposureRoutes: inhalation, ingestion, skin and/or eye contact
0296.symptoms: irritation eyes; skin, throat; skin burns, dermatitis; lacrimation (discharge of tears); rhinorrhea (discharge of thin nasal mucus); cough, dyspnea (breathing difficulty); nausea
